audit.whatIsWrong: Four level-chart rows disagree with the packet chart, with this page's own whys text, and with the mirror. The page gives Heimerdinger Level 1 while whys[0] says 'At level 1 you have one turret and no grenade' and a Fling can run you down; it gives Singed Levels 3 and 4-5 while whys[2] and whys[3] describe a nest he can only proxy around; and it gives Singed First item where the packet says Skill.
audit.why: Packet chart is Singed, Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Skill, Singed. The mirror (singed__heimerdinger) already realigned to exactly that as an atomic group — 'Level 1 to Singed, Levels 3 and 4-5 to Heimerdinger, First item to Skill'. Leaving mine as-is would make the two directions contradict each other on four of seven rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3 and 5 flipped in both layers as one paired group, matching the packet and the mirror. Ratings and the phase whys moved with the sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike blocks and phase whys carry no cooldown numbers at all — 'trade around Fling's cooldown', 'Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in'.
audit.why: The numbers are what make the advice usable: Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s at 125 range, Mega Adhesive 17s at rank 1, Insanity Potion a flat 100s. On your side CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank and UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70s.
audit.corrected: Fling's 10s, Mega Adhesive's 17s, UPGRADE!!! at 100s and the flat-11s grenade written into the phases, spikes, cooldown block and mid/early prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) 'CH-3X center-stun' appears five times — a fabricated ability name. (b) The decisive Fling interaction is never stated: dontsFull[1] says 'Get E-flipped into goo' and stops there.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's stun is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade; there is no CH-3X in the kit, and it stuns only 'anyone directly hit' while merely slowing the surrounding area. Riot's Fling text: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' That root, on a champion with no dash and no escape, is how you actually die in this lane — and it means his W placement before the Fling is the tell to watch, not the Fling itself.
audit.corrected: CH-3X replaced with CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade everywhere it appeared; the Fling-into-Mega-Adhesive root written into dontsFull[1], the cooldown block, report[5] and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.late says 'anti-heal stays core' but never says the anti-heal runs both ways.
audit.why: Insanity Potion makes his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds for its full 100s. That is a cut to your own sustain during exactly the window you most want to survive, and nothing on the page mentions it.

The packet flags wants.you[2] 'Ride Hextech Affinity' as a probable wrong name. It is a false positive — Hextech Affinity is Heimerdinger's real passive and the line's claim (movement speed near your own structures) matches Riot's text. Left untouched.

edits.before: Level 1 is his, not yours — you have one turret and no grenade, and a single Fling into his Poison Trail can run you down before the nest exists, so respect the all-in and don't walk into Fling range. The moment your second turret and the slowing electron beams come online at 2-3 you start clawing the lane back; place turrets between you and him so a Fling has to drag you through your own crossfire. Never throw a turret charge or step up without CH-3X off cooldown — the center-stun is the only thing that stops his run-up, and burning it on the wave leaves you naked for the next Fling.
edits.after: Level 1 is his, not yours — you have one turret and no grenade, and a single Fling into his Poison Trail can run you down before the nest exists, so respect the all-in and stay outside its 125 range. The moment your second turret and the slowing electron beams come online at 2-3 you start clawing the lane back; place turrets between you and him so a Fling has to drag you through your own crossfire. Never step up without CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade ready — it is 11s flat, it only stuns on a direct hit, and it is the one thing that stops his run-up.

edits.before: This is your window. By 4-5 three banked H-28G turrets plus the CH-3X center-stun make a direct Fling-in suicidal — hit the stun, let the beams chunk him, and he can't out-sustain three buildings while pinned in place. At 6 your UPGRADE!!! grenade gets wider and stuns longer, the rare hard-lock on a champ who normally slips every single CC, so save it for his engage. The catch: he doesn't have to fight your nest — expect him to proxy the wave behind you and farm safely while his Mega Adhesive zones you off CS, so deny what you can and punish hard whenever he actually steps into the turret line.

At 6 UPGRADE!!! goes wider and stuns longer on a 100s cooldown, the rare hard-lock on a champ who slips every other CC, so save it for his engage. The catch: he doesn't have to fight your nest — expect him to proxy the wave behind you while Mega Adhesive, 17s at rank 1, zones you off CS, so punish hard whenever he steps into the turret line.

notes: Killed 'CH-3X center-stun', which appeared five times (whys[3], spikes[0].text, early, mid, wants.you[0]). Heimerdinger's stun is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, a flat 11s at all ranks, and Riot's text stuns only 'anyone directly hit' — the surrounding area is slowed, so a graze is not a stun. The page's single most important missing interaction is now stated: Riot on Fling, 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' Against a champion with no dash that root is the kill, and it means the tell to watch is his W going down before the flip, not the flip itself. LEVEL CHART realigned as a paired atomic group on rows 0, 2, 3 and 5 to match the packet chart and the mirror, which already made the identical four flips; four rows previously contradicted this page's own whys text. Also added that Insanity Potion makes his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds for its full 100s, which cuts your sustain during the exact window you are trying to survive. PACKET DEFECT is a false positive: suspectNames flags 'Ride Hextech Affinity' in wants.you[2], but Hextech Affinity is Heimerdinger's real passive and the line describes it correctly. Left alone.
